SECTION 1 Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance is
hereby amended by changing all of Ml-2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Parks District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 22-F in the area bounded by:

        West 89"^ Street; South Holland Road; a line 249.19 feet south of West

        west of and parallel to South Holland Road; And a line 143.46 feet west

to those of a M2-2 Light Industry District.

publication.
